finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker-controlled value for 'prio' could be used to manipulate the thread creation parameters.
finding.assumptions: The 'prio' variable is influenced by user input, and 'insertionSort' could potentially execute system commands.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker-controlled value in 'ALGO_TEXT[1]' or 'DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0]' could be used to inject malicious escape sequences or control characters.
finding.assumptions: The strings 'ALGO_TEXT[1]' and 'DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0]' are influenced by user input and could be crafted to execute malicious commands.
